description: Identify the likely carrier for a package tracking number and return a direct tracking link. Supports common USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and Amazon formats. Live delivery status, location, estimated arrival, and history are not fetched by this tool yet; open the returned carrier link for the current shipment record. Just paste the tracking number - the carrier is detected automatically.

tracking_number.description: Package tracking number from any carrier

name: package_track
